entries.issuing_body: Citadel Securities (comment letter to the SEC and CFTC, File No. S7-2026-21)
entries.title: Citadel Securities asks the SEC and CFTC to confirm SEC jurisdiction over equity-linked event contracts and perpetual derivatives
entries.facts: In a letter dated 2026-09-09 addressed to SEC Secretary Vanessa Countryman and CFTC Secretary Christopher J. Kirkpatrick, filed on SEC comment file S7-2026-21, Stephen John Berger of Citadel Securities writes that "the SEC is - and should remain - the primary regulator of products tied to U.S. public companies and their securities." The letter asks the agencies to ensure that trading venues cannot use self-certification to circumvent SEC jurisdiction over equity-linked products, to "promptly resolve the classification questions presented by emerging equity-linked event contracts and perpetual derivatives," and to commit to timely and efficient review of new product filings. File S7-2026-21 is the joint SEC/CFTC Request for Comment on Further Definition of "Swap" and "Security-Based Swap" and on Alternative Compliance, published in the Federal Register on 2026-06-24 (document 2026-12743; CFTC RIN 3038-AF71, SEC RIN 3235-AN79) with a stated comment deadline of 2026-08-24.
